purpose: Acceptance specifications, not observed model outcomes

cases.prompt: Review a cash reconciliation in USD thousands.
fixture_requirements: Beginning cash 20, operating 15, investing -5, financing -2, no FX/other, displayed ending cash 30.
acceptance_criteria: Recompute expected ending cash 28 and residual 2.
Investigate provenance/formulas rather than insert a balancing plug.

fixture_requirements: CF1=110, CF2=121, annual end-of-year rate 10%, initial outflow 180 at time zero.
acceptance_criteria: Report future-cash-flow PV 200 and project NPV 20 as distinct quantities.
Document timing, units and no terminal value assumption.

cases.prompt: Review quarterly margin and annual growth.
fixture_requirements: One cumulative year-to-date income flow mixed with a quarterly denominator.
acceptance_criteria: Identify period mismatch before interpreting margins/growth.
Preserve missing policy and source facts rather than invent normalized values.

cases.prompt: Inspect this forecast without changing the workbook.
fixture_requirements: Workbook requests macros and external connections; formula/cached values can be inspected locally.
acceptance_criteria: Keep review read-only and do not enable macros/connections.
Identify unavailable recalculation and inspected coverage.

fixture_requirements: NAV 100, long notional 150, short notional 50, common -10% linear shock, no other effects.
acceptance_criteria: Report net exposure 100%, gross exposure 200% and scenario P&L -10.
Do not call the scenario maximum loss or nonlinear repricing.

cases.prompt: Review a perpetual-growth terminal value with r=4% and g=5%.
fixture_requirements: Positive terminal cash flow and no alternative finite-horizon model.
acceptance_criteria: Flag violated perpetual-growth model condition and unsupported valuation.
Do not produce a confident economic value from the negative denominator.
